# groover-hangar

> x402 USDC shops for coding agents. Mill (0xray) is the suit. These are the shops.
> No Groover login. To settle: funded local OWS (~/.ows, USDC on Base) or awal. Unpaid GET is 402 with no wallet.

npm: groover-hangar
install: npx groover-hangar
factory: https://website-production-c0da.up.railway.app/suit
repo: https://github.com/htafolla/groover
marketplace: grok plugin marketplace add htafolla/groover

## Shops (live, Base USDC)

- extract $0.02 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/extract?url=
- witness $0.02 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/witness?url=
- pin $0.01 https://clearing-production-9968.up.railway.app/v1/pin?agentId=

Unpaid GET → HTTP 402. Never twice on the same paymentId. Hosted ZigZag /sign is 410.

## Related

- mill/suit: npm 0xray and @0xray/foundry (not this package)
- kit: local ZigZag/OWS or CLEARING_SIGNER=awal
- do not mill-plant Clearing into 0xray
- do not dump 45-skill 0xray costume
